chunks: Why then did the gods they had taken apart from God as propitiators not come to their aid? In fact they strayed away from them. It was all a lie what they had contrived!
ai.seo_question: Why did the idols fail to help their worshippers?
ai.summary: This verse critiques the polytheists' reliance on intermediaries, asserting that these 'gods' were merely creations that failed to assist them, thereby exposing their belief as a self-invented falsehood. In Shia exegesis, this highlights the insufficiency of created beings as intercessors without divine permission, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid (Oneness of God) against Shirk (associating partners with God). The phrase 'that is their lie' underscores the cognitive dissonance of attributing power to the powerless.
